properties.name: AreaLightEnabled
properties.description: Enable this emitter. Studio hiding its control renderer also disables its contribution.

properties.name: AreaLightColor
properties.description: Emitter color, decoded using AreaLightColorInput before entering the linear scene protocol.

properties.name: AreaLightRadiance
properties.description: Linear radiance multiplier, not lumens or Unity point-light intensity. Larger area at fixed radiance emits more total light. Distance falloff is already integrated.

properties.name: AreaLightWidth
properties.description: Emitter width before object transform scaling. Local +Z is the emitting front.

properties.name: AreaLightHeight
properties.description: Emitter height before object transform scaling. Rotate the Studio item to aim its local +Z at the subject.

properties.name: AreaLightTwoSided
properties.description: Allow emission from both sides of the plane. This does not enable shadows or make the carrier visible.

properties.name: AreaLightPriority
properties.description: Higher priority is selected first. The prototype supports at most four emitters per camera; overflow is ignored.

properties.name: AreaLightColorInput
properties.description: 0: ME sRGB color values, decoded once. 1: values already describe linear radiance. Does not change the game's color space.

properties.name: GlintMask
properties.description: Linear red channel multiplies GlintWeight. White or no map preserves the scalar; black restores smooth direct specular. Independent ST affects only the mask, not the stable UV microstructure. Does not clip coverage.

properties.name: MainTex
properties.description: RGB base color; white multiplies BaseColor unchanged. Alpha is used only by BSDFCutout.

properties.name: NormalMap
properties.description: Normal data. Encoding is explicit; use UnityPacked for Unity-imported normals, RGB for blue normals, AG for exported alpha/green normals.

properties.name: MetallicMap
properties.description: Red channel multiplies Metallic. White or no map keeps the scalar.

properties.name: RoughnessMap
properties.description: Red channel multiplies perceptual Roughness. White or no map keeps the scalar; black is smooth.

properties.name: OcclusionMap
properties.description: Red channel multiplies Occlusion. Affects indirect diffuse and optionally probe specular through SpecularOcclusionStrength; never direct lights or emission.

properties.name: ORMMap
properties.description: Optional packed data: R=occlusion, G=roughness, B=metallic. Enabled by UseORM; multiplies the corresponding scalar values.

properties.name: EmissionMask
properties.description: RGB emission multiplied by EmissionColor and EmissionIntensity. Black or no texture produces no emission.

properties.name: AnisotropyMap
properties.description: Linear red-channel data multiplies Anisotropy. White or no texture retains the slider; black is isotropic. Independent ST; shares RoughnessMap filtering/wrap sampler.

properties.name: AnisotropyRotationMap
properties.description: Linear red-channel angle adds 0..360 degrees to AnisotropyRotation in the mesh UV tangent frame. Black or no texture adds zero. Independent ST; shares RoughnessMap sampler. Avoid filtered discontinuities between 0 and 1; opposite directions describe the same unoriented lobe.

properties.name: NormalMapDetail
properties.description: Independent detail normal, reoriented onto the base normal using RNM. Its UV scale and offset are independent of MainTex and NormalMap.

properties.name: BaseColor
properties.description: Base reflectance color. For dielectrics this is diffuse color; for metals it is normal-incidence specular reflectance.

properties.name: Metallic
properties.description: 0 is dielectric, 1 is conductor. Fractional values mix the two; metals have no diffuse lobe.

properties.name: Roughness
properties.description: GGX perceptual roughness; microfacet alpha=r*r with only a numerical alpha floor of 0.001.

properties.name: DiffuseRoughness
properties.description: EON diffuse roughness; 0 is Lambert. Does not change the GGX specular roughness.

properties.name: IOR
properties.description: Dielectric interface IOR relative to air. F0=((IOR-1)/(IOR+1))^2; IOR=1 disables dielectric interface reflection.

properties.name: SpecularWeight
properties.description: Weights the dielectric reflection lobe, including grazing reflection. Metals are unaffected. 1 is the physical interface reference.

properties.name: SpecularColor
properties.description: Tint of dielectric normal-incidence reflection. White is the physically neutral dielectric reference.

properties.name: UseORM
properties.description: 0 uses separate metallic/roughness/AO maps; 1 reads ORM. This is a float branch and works with MaterialEditor without keywords.

properties.name: NormalMapScale
properties.description: Scales decoded tangent-space XY then normalizes. 0 is a flat normal in every encoding.

properties.name: NormalEncoding
properties.description: 0=Unity native packed normal, 1=raw RGB XYZ, 2=raw AG XY with positive Z reconstructed. No automatic color-based guessing.

properties.name: NormalFlipY
properties.description: Flips the decoded tangent-space Y component, for the opposite normal-map convention.

properties.name: NormalDataRestore
properties.description: For raw RGB/AG only: in Linear projects, undo automatic sRGB texture decoding when the data was imported as color. Leave 0 for correctly imported linear data.

properties.name: DetailNormalMapScale
properties.description: 0 disables detail normal sampling and preserves the base normal. Increase after assigning a detail texture and its encoding.

properties.name: DetailNormalEncoding
properties.description: 0=UnityPacked, 1=raw RGB, 2=raw AG. Independent from the main normal encoding; AG reconstructs positive Z.

properties.name: DetailNormalFlipY
properties.description: Flips only the detail map tangent-space Y component before RNM blending.

properties.name: DetailNormalDataRestore
properties.description: For raw RGB/AG detail data incorrectly imported as color in a Linear project. Leave off for correctly imported normal data and in Gamma hosts.

properties.name: HeightMap
properties.description: Height-v1 linear red channel, with its own tiling, offset, filter and wrap. White is the mesh envelope; black is HeightScale meters below it. Reverse is applied after data restoration. POM moves surface samples only, never coverage, shadow geometry, glass thickness or coat thickness. Use a matching normal map for lighting detail.

properties.name: ParallaxMode
properties.description: 0 Off preserves the accepted pre-POM sampling. 1 POM traces the view ray through HeightMap, shifting material, normal/detail and coat/film maps together before each map's own ST. No plugin or saved keyword is required. UV-only: real depth, silhouette, light position and native shadows stay on the mesh.

properties.name: HeightScale
properties.description: Maximum inward relief in world meters, corrected for UV density and nonuniform object scale. Zero bypasses height sampling and preserves pre-POM appearance regardless of the other height controls. White height remains at the mesh. This does not displace vertices or write pixel depth.

properties.name: IsHeightReverse
properties.description: Reverse decoded height with h=1-h before tracing. Normally white is high and black is recessed; reversed black is high. This does not invert alpha, coverage or any mask.

properties.name: ParallaxQuality
properties.description: 0 Realtime: 12-32 angle-adaptive steps and 2 intersection refinements. 1 Reference: 32-96 steps and 5 refinements. Both preserve the same height/UV model and bounded gradients. Reference is a higher sampling budget, not an exact ray-traced ground truth. Each native ForwardAdd repeats the camera-ray search.

properties.name: ParallaxFadeStart
properties.description: Eye distance where relief starts smoothly fading to the mesh. Far/end and mip/grazing guards only affect relief; they do not fade coverage or material brightness.

properties.name: ParallaxFadeEnd
properties.description: Eye distance where relief becomes flat. Values not above Fade Start are safely treated as a short positive interval. Very coarse height mips also fade relief automatically.

properties.name: ParallaxGrazingFade
properties.description: View-normal cosine below which relief smoothly weakens. Limits instability at nearly tangent views; zero silhouette expansion and exact depth remain outside UV-only POM.

properties.name: ParallaxMaxOffset
properties.description: Maximum full-ray excursion measured in HeightMap UV units after height tiling. Limits extreme offsets continuously by reducing effective relief, not by clipping the final UV. Texture wrap remains the HeightMap sampler's own setting. Atlas islands still require sufficient padding.

properties.name: ParallaxSelfShadow
properties.description: Optional local height-field visibility per native directional, point, spot and four-array fallback light. Default Off preserves the accepted POM appearance. Shadows the entire direct layered response once, not coverage, emission, SH, Probe or rectangle lights. No plugin or replacement shadow map is required.

properties.name: ParallaxSelfShadowStrength
properties.description: Blend local height visibility into each native direct light. One applies the full estimated occlusion; zero bypasses the light-ray trace. Coat and thin film share one conformal relief surface and one visibility. Does not provide environmental occlusion or simulate a coat filling grooves.

properties.name: ParallaxSelfShadowBias
properties.description: Dimensionless multiplier for the automatic effective-height and texture-footprint self-intersection bias. Larger values suppress acne but can leak light across fine relief. Quality follows ParallaxQuality: Realtime 8-16, Reference 24-48 light-ray steps. Grazing or excessive UV excursions fade to unshadowed local visibility; native shadows are retained.

properties.name: Anisotropy
properties.description: OpenPBR-style GGX axis stretch; multiplied by AnisotropyMap red. 0 uses the original isotropic BRDF/LUT/probe path. 1 is numerically regularized per axis. Direct light uses anisotropic GGX/Smith and directional energy compensation; native Probe IBL uses an approximate bent reflection vector, not exact elliptical convolution.

properties.name: AnisotropyRotation
properties.description: Rotates the broad-slope tangent axis about the final shading normal in the UV frame; rotation-map red adds a full turn. 180 degrees is visually equivalent; 90 degrees swaps highlight axes. Mirrored UV and negative transforms preserve frame handedness.

properties.name: SpecularAAStrength
properties.description: Filters GGX from final-normal derivatives. Anisotropy broadens both squared slope axes and filters direction variation; direct light, DFG and IBL share the effective parameters. 0 restores unfiltered parameters. Cannot recover subpixel variance lost by compression/mips.

properties.name: SpecularAAVariance
properties.description: Weight of normal and anisotropic-direction derivatives. Larger values reduce tiny sharp highlights and isotropize rapidly varying directions. Neutral for a spatially constant normal and direction frame.

properties.name: SpecularAAThreshold
properties.description: Bounds the filtering kernel in microfacet-alpha space: added alpha-squared is at most threshold-squared times AA strength. 0 disables broadening.

properties.name: GlintWeight
properties.description: 0 preserves the previous material. 1 replaces native direct-light substrate single scattering with footprint-filtered statistical glints. Coat, multiple scattering, diffuse, emission, SH, Probe and rectangles retain their existing response. No plugin or keyword required.

properties.name: GlintDensity
properties.description: Log10 statistical facets per original UV unit area: 6 means one million. Higher density or larger pixel footprints converge toward smooth GGX. Not world-meter density; UV islands with different texel density need authoring adjustment.

properties.name: GlintContrast
properties.description: Statistical sparsity: R=10^(-3*value). Higher values give fewer, brighter events at the same expected reflection, not an energy multiplier or another roughness. Extremely rare unresolved events continuously retain the smooth mean.

properties.name: GlintSeed
properties.description: Rounded integer material seed, saved by ME. Changes the stable UV and angular statistical field. Time, frame number and light index never reseed it. Mirrored or repeated UV charts repeat the pattern.

properties.name: CoatMask
properties.description: Red channel multiplies CoatWeight. Coverage blends complete bare and coated materials, not only the top highlight.

properties.name: CoatRoughnessMap
properties.description: Red channel multiplies coat perceptual roughness. Shares the RoughnessMap sampler filter and wrap settings.

properties.name: CoatWeight
properties.description: Coating coverage. Zero uses the energy-corrected bare material and ignores every coat/film control. The stage-3 audit intentionally updates the old dielectric/mixed-metal baseline.

properties.name: CoatIOR
properties.description: Coat refractive index. Controls top Fresnel, substrate relative IOR, refraction path length and internal trapping.

properties.name: CoatRoughness
properties.description: Perceptual GGX roughness of the isotropic top interface. Also broadens both substrate anisotropic axes through rough transmission.

properties.name: CoatNormalMap
properties.description: Independent coat normal, using the selected normal encoding. Shares the RoughnessMap sampler.

properties.name: CoatNormalScale
properties.description: Coat normal strength. Zero is neutral for every encoding; base normals remain independent.

properties.name: CoatNormalBaseBlend
properties.description: Zero starts from smooth mesh normal; one inherits the base/detail normal before RNM coat normal composition.

properties.name: CoatNormalEncoding
properties.description: 0=Unity packed; 1=RGB normal; 2=alpha/green packed. Select based on actual texture storage.

properties.name: CoatNormalFlipY
properties.description: Invert tangent-space Y only on the coat normal.

properties.name: CoatNormalDataRestore
properties.description: Restore RGB data accidentally imported as sRGB in Linear mode. UnityPacked is unaffected.

properties.name: CoatThicknessMap
properties.description: Red channel multiplies coat thickness in millimeters. This absorption distance is not nanometer thin-film thickness.

properties.name: CoatAbsorptionColor
properties.description: Linear single-pass transmission at CoatAbsorptionDistance. White means no absorption; not a tint added to reflections.

properties.name: CoatAbsorptionDistance
properties.description: Distance in millimeters at which the transmission equals CoatAbsorptionColor.

properties.name: CoatThickness
properties.description: Medium thickness in millimeters. Reflections traverse down and up; emission traverses only the escape path.

properties.name: ThinFilmMask
properties.description: Red channel multiplies ThinFilmWeight within the coat-covered region only.

properties.name: ThinFilmThicknessMap
properties.description: Red channel multiplies ThinFilmThickness in nanometers. Data, not color; shared material-data sampler.

properties.name: ThinFilmWeight
properties.description: Optional interfering substrate interface beneath coat. Zero keeps plain coat; CoatWeight zero disables film too.

properties.name: ThinFilmIOR
properties.description: Film refractive index, independent of coat and base IOR. RGB metal optical constants are an effective fit, not measured spectral data.

properties.name: ThinFilmQuality
properties.description: 0: Realtime, using a shader-owned positive GGX energy projection table. Direct film interference is unchanged. High-contrast or thick low-index films smoothly return to the reference path. 1: Reference, the preserved 256-512 sample integral; much more expensive. Both modes are neutral when film or coat weight is zero.

properties.name: ThinFilmThickness
properties.description: Optical interference thickness in nanometers. Below 30 nm the film smoothly fades into the plain substrate; this is not a calibrated ultrathin oxide model. Spatial phase filtering reduces distant flicker.

properties.name: Occlusion
properties.description: Scalar ambient visibility; white mask or no map leaves this value unchanged. Also feeds the separately controlled specular-occlusion approximation.

properties.name: OcclusionStrength
properties.description: Blends ambient visibility from 1 to Occlusion times its map. Does not change direct-light shadows.

properties.name: IndirectDiffuseIntensity
properties.description: Scales the blended Unity SH and Tom SH Volume diffuse illumination. Does not create bounced light when no environment data exists.

properties.name: ReflectionIntensity
properties.description: Scales decoded native reflection-probe radiance. Supports two probes, box projection and Unity sky fallback. Does not scale direct-light specular.

properties.name: ProbeBoxProjection
properties.description: Enables each native probe's parallax box projection when the probe and Unity renderer provide it. Does not turn a sky cubemap into a local probe.

properties.name: ProbeBlending
properties.description: Blends two native probes using Unity's receiver weights, in decoded linear radiance. Renderer must allow BlendProbes or BlendProbesAndSkybox. Off uses probe 0 only.

properties.name: CustomSHVolumeBlend
properties.description: Receives the existing Tom Lighting Probes SH volume MPB contract. Blends over native SH with per-pixel edge fading; falls back when missing, disabled or outside. Current runtime plugin targets CharaStudio.

properties.name: SpecularOcclusionStrength
properties.description: Approximate view/roughness-aware visibility from ambient occlusion, for probe specular only. 0 preserves unoccluded reflections; white AO is neutral. Not ray-traced occlusion.

properties.name: SpecularHorizonStrength
properties.description: Fades probe reflections directed below the geometric surface by a perturbed normal. Does not multiply direct lights or emission; 0 disables this fade.

properties.name: SceneLighting
properties.description: Accept the optional KKS companion v1 rectangle lights. Off, missing companion, or an incompatible protocol contributes exactly zero. Does not replace native lights, Probe or SH.

properties.name: AreaLightIntensity
properties.description: Multiplier for rectangle direct lighting only. Scene emitter colors are linear radiance; solid angle supplies geometric falloff. Prototype has no occlusion or area-light shadows.

properties.name: AreaLightQuality
properties.description: 0: unchanged Realtime (LTC plus 16 residual samples for bare isotropic; 32 per MIS proposal for layered/anisotropic). 1: preserved 128-sample Reference. The optional companion synchronizes these ME floats to camera-scoped local variants; no saved keyword edits. Screenshot Reference can temporarily promote render/depth/video captures without changing this value or thin-film quality. Off/missing companion keeps native lights, probes and SH unchanged.

properties.name: EmissionColor
properties.description: Emission color multiplied by the RGB emission map. Emission is added once in ForwardBase and is unaffected by AO.

properties.name: EmissionIntensity
properties.description: Linear emission gain applied after decoding color; no per-material tone mapping.

properties.name: CullOption
properties.description: 0=two-sided, 1=cull front, 2=cull back. The caster uses the same mode; two-sided shading flips the normal frame.

properties.name: ColorTextureMode
properties.description: 0=KKS Linear sampling convention, 1=sampled RGB is explicitly sRGB encoded, 2=sampled RGB is already linear. Auto does not decode values a second time, even in a Gamma-built bundle. Controls MainTex and EmissionMask; alpha is never gamma decoded.

properties.name: ColorValueMode
properties.description: 0=KKS Linear color-uniform convention, 1=explicit sRGB values, 2=explicit linear values. Applies to color controls, not numeric gains. Gamma authoring previews are not the KKS display pipeline.

properties.name: DataTextureRestore
properties.description: 0=preserve sampled scalar data; 1=undo unwanted sRGB decoding of data in the KKS Linear player, independent of the bundle build color space. Covers roughness, metallic, AO, ORM, anisotropy strength/rotation and AlphaMask red. Leave off for correctly imported data maps.

properties.name: LightColorInput
properties.description: 0=treat Unity combined RGB/intensity as linear numeric light units, preserving intensity ratios. 1=decode the combined value as sRGB; this cannot separately recover light color and intensity in Gamma hosts.

properties.name: ReflectionColorMode
properties.description: After KKS Linear HDR decoding: 0=linear KKS radiance, 1=explicit sRGB radiance, 2=already linear radiance. RGBM exponent decoding is independent of the Gamma authoring project. No companion plugin is required for native probes.

properties.name: CustomSHColorMode
properties.description: 0=KKS linear SH, 1=decode evaluated SH as sRGB, 2=linear SH. Use 1 only for a known legacy Gamma capture; post-evaluation decoding is approximate, not exact linear GI. Native Unity SH remains linear and works without the companion.

properties.name: DebugView
properties.description: 0=shaded, 1=linear albedo, 2=world normal, 3=AO/effective roughness/metallic, 4=coverage, 5=main attenuation, 6=fallback lights, 7=blended SH, 8=probe radiance, 9=specular visibility, 10=AA roughness, 11=custom SH blend, 12=world anisotropy tangent, 13=alphaT/alphaB/effective anisotropy, 14=DFG A/B/missing average. Add passes output zero in debug views.

High-contrast or thick low-index films smoothly return to the reference path. 1: Reference, the preserved 256-512 sample integral; much more expensive. Both modes are neutral when film or coat weight is zero.

properties.name: ThinFilmThickness
properties.description: Optical interference thickness in nanometers. Below 30 nm the film smoothly fades into the plain substrate; this is not a calibrated ultrathin oxide model. Spatial phase filtering reduces distant flicker.

properties.name: Occlusion
properties.description: Scalar ambient visibility; white mask or no map leaves this value unchanged. Also feeds the separately controlled specular-occlusion approximation.

properties.name: OcclusionStrength
properties.description: Blends ambient visibility from 1 to Occlusion times its map. Does not change direct-light shadows.

properties.name: IndirectDiffuseIntensity
properties.description: Scales the blended Unity SH and Tom SH Volume diffuse illumination. Does not create bounced light when no environment data exists.

properties.name: ReflectionIntensity
properties.description: Scales decoded native reflection-probe radiance. Supports two probes, box projection and Unity sky fallback. Does not scale direct-light specular.

properties.name: ProbeBoxProjection
properties.description: Enables each native probe's parallax box projection when the probe and Unity renderer provide it. Does not turn a sky cubemap into a local probe.

properties.name: ProbeBlending
properties.description: Blends two native probes using Unity's receiver weights, in decoded linear radiance. Renderer must allow BlendProbes or BlendProbesAndSkybox. Off uses probe 0 only.

properties.name: CustomSHVolumeBlend
properties.description: Receives the existing Tom Lighting Probes SH volume MPB contract. Blends over native SH with per-pixel edge fading; falls back when missing, disabled or outside. Current runtime plugin targets CharaStudio.

properties.name: SpecularOcclusionStrength
properties.description: Approximate view/roughness-aware visibility from ambient occlusion, for probe specular only. 0 preserves unoccluded reflections; white AO is neutral. Not ray-traced occlusion.

properties.name: SpecularHorizonStrength
properties.description: Fades probe reflections directed below the geometric surface by a perturbed normal. Does not multiply direct lights or emission; 0 disables this fade.

properties.name: SceneLighting
properties.description: Accept the optional KKS companion v1 rectangle lights. Off, missing companion, or an incompatible protocol contributes exactly zero. Does not replace native lights, Probe or SH.

properties.name: AreaLightIntensity
properties.description: Multiplier for rectangle direct lighting only. Scene emitter colors are linear radiance; solid angle supplies geometric falloff. Prototype has no occlusion or area-light shadows.

properties.name: AreaLightQuality
properties.description: 0: unchanged Realtime (LTC plus 16 residual samples for bare isotropic; 32 per MIS proposal for layered/anisotropic). 1: preserved 128-sample Reference. The optional companion synchronizes these ME floats to camera-scoped local variants; no saved keyword edits. Screenshot Reference can temporarily promote render/depth/video captures without changing this value or thin-film quality. Off/missing companion keeps native lights, probes and SH unchanged.

properties.name: EmissionColor
properties.description: Emission color multiplied by the RGB emission map. Emission is added once in ForwardBase and is unaffected by AO.

properties.name: EmissionIntensity
properties.description: Linear emission gain applied after decoding color; no per-material tone mapping.

properties.name: Coverage
properties.description: Final coverage = MainTex.a * AlphaMask.r * Coverage. Cutout tests a threshold; Alpha fades the complete reflected/emitted surface. This is geometric coverage, not glass transmission.

properties.name: Cutoff
properties.description: Shared threshold for visible Base/Add passes and ShadowCaster. Zero coverage is always discarded.

properties.name: AlphaClip
properties.description: Optional binary cutoff before smooth premultiplied blending. Uses Cutoff consistently in color, optional depth and shadows. Off keeps the mask gradient. Zero coverage is always absent.

properties.name: AlphaDepthMode
properties.description: 0=Off: color never writes depth. 1=Nearest surface: depth-only prepass limits self-overlap but hides deeper transparent layers. 2=Back shell: nearest back-facing shell blocks deeper layers; useful with BackFront on closed meshes. Both use AlphaDepthCutoff, not color clipping. Not OIT; can occlude later transparent objects and does not automatically enter camera depth textures.

properties.name: AlphaDepthCutoff
properties.description: Minimum coverage allowed to write optional prepass depth. Does not remove lower-coverage color. Default only treats near-opaque pixels as occluders. Set below the sheet coverage only when nearest-layer/back-shell occlusion is intended.

properties.name: AlphaShadowMode
properties.description: Shadow CASTING only: 0=Off. 1=Binary cutoff using AlphaShadowCutoff. 2=Fixed 4x4 ordered coverage in shadow-map raster space: approximate fractional visibility, filtered by Unity shadows. No colored transmission, refraction or temporal noise. Receiving is independent: companion 0.4.0 can reuse available native shadow maps; disabled or missing resources retain the native transparent fallback.

properties.name: AlphaShadowCutoff
properties.description: Binary coverage threshold for AlphaShadowMode=1 only. Independent from depth cutoff and optional visible cutoff. Zero coverage never casts a shadow.

properties.name: ColorTextureMode
properties.description: 0=KKS Linear sampling convention, 1=sampled RGB is explicitly sRGB encoded, 2=sampled RGB is already linear. Auto does not decode values a second time, even in a Gamma-built bundle. Controls MainTex and EmissionMask; alpha is never gamma decoded.

properties.name: ColorValueMode
properties.description: 0=KKS Linear color-uniform convention, 1=explicit sRGB values, 2=explicit linear values. Applies to color controls, not numeric gains. Gamma authoring previews are not the KKS display pipeline.

properties.name: DataTextureRestore
properties.description: 0=preserve sampled scalar data; 1=undo unwanted sRGB decoding of data in the KKS Linear player, independent of the bundle build color space. Covers roughness, metallic, AO, ORM, anisotropy strength/rotation and AlphaMask red. Leave off for correctly imported data maps.

properties.name: LightColorInput
properties.description: 0=treat Unity combined RGB/intensity as linear numeric light units, preserving intensity ratios. 1=decode the combined value as sRGB; this cannot separately recover light color and intensity in Gamma hosts.

properties.name: ReflectionColorMode
properties.description: After KKS Linear HDR decoding: 0=linear KKS radiance, 1=explicit sRGB radiance, 2=already linear radiance. RGBM exponent decoding is independent of the Gamma authoring project. No companion plugin is required for native probes.

properties.name: CustomSHColorMode
properties.description: 0=KKS linear SH, 1=decode evaluated SH as sRGB, 2=linear SH. Use 1 only for a known legacy Gamma capture; post-evaluation decoding is approximate, not exact linear GI. Native Unity SH remains linear and works without the companion.

properties.name: DebugView
properties.description: 0=shaded, 1=linear albedo, 2=world normal, 3=AO/effective roughness/metallic, 4=coverage, 5=main attenuation, 6=fallback lights, 7=blended SH, 8=probe radiance, 9=specular visibility, 10=AA roughness, 11=custom SH blend, 12=world anisotropy tangent, 13=alphaT/alphaB/effective anisotropy, 14=DFG A/B/missing average. Add passes output zero in debug views.

properties.name: MainTex
properties.description: RGB multiplies BaseColor and GlassAbsorptionColor to define transmission after GlassAbsorptionDistance in meters. White is no absorption. A independently multiplies geometric coverage; it does not control optical transmission or Fresnel.

properties.name: NormalMap
properties.description: Normal data. Encoding is explicit; use UnityPacked for Unity-imported normals, RGB for blue normals, AG for exported alpha/green normals.

properties.name: NormalMapDetail
properties.description: Independent detail normal, reoriented onto the base normal using RNM. Its UV scale and offset are independent of MainTex and NormalMap.

properties.name: RoughnessMap
properties.description: Red channel multiplies perceptual Roughness. White or no map keeps the scalar; black is smooth.

properties.name: OcclusionMap
properties.description: Red channel multiplies Occlusion. Affects indirect diffuse and optionally probe specular through SpecularOcclusionStrength; never direct lights or emission.

properties.name: EmissionMask
properties.description: RGB emission multiplied by EmissionColor and EmissionIntensity. Black or no texture produces no emission.

properties.name: AlphaMask
properties.description: Red channel multiplies MainTex alpha and Coverage. This is independent of the old skin alpha_a/alpha_b compatibility processing.

properties.name: AnisotropyMap
properties.description: Linear red-channel data multiplies Anisotropy. White or no texture retains the slider; black is isotropic. Independent ST; shares RoughnessMap filtering/wrap sampler.

properties.name: AnisotropyRotationMap
properties.description: Linear red-channel angle adds 0..360 degrees to AnisotropyRotation in the mesh UV tangent frame. Black or no texture adds zero. Independent ST; shares RoughnessMap sampler. Avoid filtered discontinuities between 0 and 1; opposite directions describe the same unoriented lobe.

properties.name: GlassThicknessMap
properties.description: Linear red channel multiplies GlassThickness. Independent UV scale/offset; shares RoughnessMap filtering/wrapping. This is supplied thickness, not measured back-face depth.

properties.name: BaseColor
properties.description: Multiplies MainTex RGB and GlassAbsorptionColor as the Beer-Lambert reference color. White is clear. It never tints the dielectric interface reflection or creates diffuse paint.

properties.name: IOR
properties.description: Air/glass IOR for the locally parallel slab. Controls both GGX reflection energy and refracted path. 1 removes dielectric reflection and bending. No nested media, internal-camera medium tracking or dispersion.

properties.name: Roughness
properties.description: Perceptual roughness shared by compensated GGX reflection and the finite nine-tap elliptical screen-transmission filter. AA and anisotropy affect both. Transmission filtering is a bounded approximation, not an exact microfacet BTDF.

properties.name: NormalMapScale
properties.description: Scales decoded tangent-space XY then normalizes. 0 is a flat normal in every encoding.

properties.name: NormalEncoding
properties.description: 0=Unity native packed normal, 1=raw RGB XYZ, 2=raw AG XY with positive Z reconstructed. No automatic color-based guessing.

properties.name: NormalFlipY
properties.description: Flips the decoded tangent-space Y component, for the opposite normal-map convention.

properties.name: NormalDataRestore
properties.description: For raw RGB/AG only: in Linear projects, undo automatic sRGB texture decoding when the data was imported as color. Leave 0 for correctly imported linear data.

properties.name: DetailNormalMapScale
properties.description: 0 disables detail normal sampling and preserves the base normal. Increase after assigning a detail texture and its encoding.

properties.name: DetailNormalEncoding
properties.description: 0=UnityPacked, 1=raw RGB, 2=raw AG. Independent from the main normal encoding; AG reconstructs positive Z.

properties.name: DetailNormalFlipY
properties.description: Flips only the detail map tangent-space Y component before RNM blending.

properties.name: DetailNormalDataRestore
properties.description: For raw RGB/AG detail data incorrectly imported as color in a Linear project. Leave off for correctly imported normal data and in Gamma hosts.

properties.name: Anisotropy
properties.description: OpenPBR-style GGX axis stretch; multiplied by AnisotropyMap red. 0 uses the original isotropic BRDF/LUT/probe path. 1 is numerically regularized per axis. Direct light uses anisotropic GGX/Smith and directional energy compensation; native Probe IBL uses an approximate bent reflection vector, not exact elliptical convolution.

properties.name: AnisotropyRotation
properties.description: Rotates the broad-slope tangent axis about the final shading normal in the UV frame; rotation-map red adds a full turn. 180 degrees is visually equivalent; 90 degrees swaps highlight axes. Mirrored UV and negative transforms preserve frame handedness.

properties.name: SpecularAAStrength
properties.description: Filters GGX from final-normal derivatives. Anisotropy broadens both squared slope axes and filters direction variation; direct light, DFG and IBL share the effective parameters. 0 restores unfiltered parameters. Cannot recover subpixel variance lost by compression/mips.

properties.name: SpecularAAVariance
properties.description: Weight of normal and anisotropic-direction derivatives. Larger values reduce tiny sharp highlights and isotropize rapidly varying directions. Neutral for a spatially constant normal and direction frame.

properties.name: SpecularAAThreshold
properties.description: Bounds the filtering kernel in microfacet-alpha space: added alpha-squared is at most threshold-squared times AA strength. 0 disables broadening.

properties.name: GlassThickness
properties.description: Local normal thickness in world meters, multiplied by Thickness Map R. The inside path is thickness/cos(refracted angle). Controls Beer absorption and parallel-slab lateral displacement, not vertex movement; object scale does not silently rescale it.

properties.name: GlassAbsorptionColor
properties.description: Transmission color at GlassAbsorptionDistance, multiplied by MainTex RGB and BaseColor. Beer-Lambert absorption is path-length dependent; RGB is bounded to 0..1, A is ignored. White causes no absorption. No colored shadow casting.

properties.name: GlassAbsorptionDistance
properties.description: World-meter distance at which the combined absorption reference color is reached. Larger distance means weaker absorption at the same thickness. This is independent of geometric coverage.

properties.name: UseSceneRefraction
properties.description: Request opaque scene color/depth from companion 0.5.0 for finite slab refraction. Off, missing companion, unsupported camera or invalid depth/UV keeps the current unshifted background with the same RGB absorption and GGX reflection. No GrabPass, SSR or shadow-map rendering.

properties.name: GlassBufferResolution
properties.description: 1 Full, 2 Half. Visible glass materials share one camera color/depth copy at the highest requested resolution. Only scene refraction uses these buffers; no visible consumer means no automatic lease.

properties.name: GlassDepthBias
properties.description: Positive world-meter separation required between the glass exit and sampled opaque depth. Rejects foreground leakage and unstable depth discontinuities; rejected pixels keep unshifted transmission, not stretched screen-edge colors.

properties.name: GlassEdgeFade
properties.description: Normalized UV margin that smoothly returns screen refraction to unshifted transmission near the screen boundary. Out-of-bounds candidates are rejected, never clamped across the screen edge.

properties.description: 0 beauty; 1 slab reflection budget; 2 RGB transmission budget; 3 valid screen-refraction weight; 4 shading normal; 5 native light attenuation. Debug outputs replace the background under coverage; Add is suppressed.

properties.name: NormalMap
properties.description: Normal data. Encoding is explicit; use UnityPacked for Unity-imported normals, RGB for blue normals, AG for exported alpha/green normals.

properties.name: MetallicMap

properties.name: OcclusionMap
properties.description: Red channel multiplies Occlusion. Affects indirect diffuse and optionally probe specular through SpecularOcclusionStrength; never direct lights or emission.

properties.name: ORMMap
properties.description: Optional packed data: R=occlusion, G=roughness, B=metallic. Enabled by UseORM; multiplies the corresponding scalar values.

properties.name: EmissionMask
properties.description: RGB emission multiplied by EmissionColor and EmissionIntensity. Black or no texture produces no emission.

properties.name: AnisotropyMap

Avoid filtered discontinuities between 0 and 1; opposite directions describe the same unoriented lobe.

properties.name: NormalMapDetail
properties.description: Independent detail normal, reoriented onto the base normal using RNM. Its UV scale and offset are independent of MainTex and NormalMap.

properties.name: BaseColor
properties.description: Base reflectance color. For dielectrics this is diffuse color; for metals it is normal-incidence specular reflectance.

properties.name: Metallic
properties.description: 0 is dielectric, 1 is conductor. Fractional values mix the two; metals have no diffuse lobe.

properties.name: Roughness
properties.description: GGX perceptual roughness; microfacet alpha=r*r with only a numerical alpha floor of 0.001.

properties.name: DiffuseRoughness
properties.description: EON diffuse roughness; 0 is Lambert. Does not change the GGX specular roughness.

properties.name: IOR
properties.description: Dielectric interface IOR relative to air. F0=((IOR-1)/(IOR+1))^2; IOR=1 disables dielectric interface reflection.

properties.name: SpecularWeight
properties.description: Weights the dielectric reflection lobe, including grazing reflection. Metals are unaffected. 1 is the physical interface reference.

properties.name: SpecularColor
properties.description: Tint of dielectric normal-incidence reflection. White is the physically neutral dielectric reference.

properties.name: UseORM
properties.description: 0 uses separate metallic/roughness/AO maps; 1 reads ORM. This is a float branch and works with MaterialEditor without keywords.

properties.name: NormalMapScale
properties.description: Scales decoded tangent-space XY then normalizes. 0 is a flat normal in every encoding.

properties.name: NormalEncoding
properties.description: 0=Unity native packed normal, 1=raw RGB XYZ, 2=raw AG XY with positive Z reconstructed. No automatic color-based guessing.

properties.name: NormalFlipY
properties.description: Flips the decoded tangent-space Y component, for the opposite normal-map convention.

properties.name: NormalDataRestore

properties.name: DetailNormalMapScale

properties.name: DetailNormalEncoding
properties.description: 0=UnityPacked, 1=raw RGB, 2=raw AG. Independent from the main normal encoding; AG reconstructs positive Z.

properties.name: DetailNormalFlipY

properties.name: DetailNormalDataRestore
properties.description: For raw RGB/AG detail data incorrectly imported as color in a Linear project. Leave off for correctly imported normal data and in Gamma hosts.

properties.name: HeightMap
properties.description: Height-v1 linear R: white is the original mesh envelope, black is HeightScale meters inward. Shared by actual Forward, caster and camera-depth geometry. Own ST and sampler; linear import recommended. No POM trace in Tess entries.

properties.name: HeightScale
properties.description: Maximum actual inward displacement in world meters, independent of object scale. Zero returns original triangles and frame with no height samples. White stays at the original mesh. CPU culling requires expanded mesh/skinned bounds: companion support or manual authoring; shader-only displacement cannot expand them.

properties.name: IsHeightReverse
properties.description: Reverse decoded height h=1-h before displacement and derivative reconstruction. Reversed black is the original envelope; reversed white is recessed. Does not reverse coverage or the displacement mask.

properties.name: DisplacementMask
properties.description: Linear R multiplies inward displacement, not coverage. White preserves height, black pins the original mesh. Paint black at incompatible UV/normal seams with a smooth transition to prevent cracks. Has its own ST and sampler.

properties.name: TessellationMode
properties.description: 0 fixed factor; 1 shared world-space edge length. Fractional-odd subdivision uses the same endpoint-only rule in ForwardBase, ForwardAdd, native shadows and camera depth. No screen-distance LOD or silhouette smoothing. Zero HeightScale bypasses sampling and returns factor 1.

properties.name: TessFactor
properties.description: Edge subdivision factor in fixed mode, capped by TessMaxFactor. Fractional-odd hardware tessellation changes segment lengths continuously; factor 1 preserves the original triangles. Triangle cost grows approximately quadratically.

properties.name: TessEdgeLength
properties.description: Target world-space edge length in world-edge mode before displacement. Smaller lengths increase tessellation. Uses transformed endpoints, so nonuniform/negative scale and skinned input are respected. Identical in all cameras and lights; no view-dependent cracks or shadow LOD mismatch.

properties.name: TessMaxFactor
properties.description: Upper bound for both tessellation modes. D3D11 fractional-odd limit is 63. This limits GPU amplification, not displacement depth; excessive factors still cost every native light and shadow pass.

properties.name: DisplacementMip
properties.description: Explicit height/mask mip, shared across all passes and cameras. 0 uses the finest level; higher values filter geometry. Fractional values use the texture sampler's mip filter. Use a linear texture with mipmaps and match geometry density; sub-triangle detail cannot appear in the silhouette. No camera-dependent automatic mip.

properties.name: DisplacementEdgeFade
properties.description: Optional crack-safe fallback: fade displacement to zero within this barycentric distance of EVERY source triangle edge. 0 preserves continuous relief. Positive values also pin UV/normal seams but can expose triangle-shaped grooves; a seam-authored displacement mask is preferable. Does not clip alpha.

properties.name: GlintWeight
properties.description: 0 preserves the previous material. 1 replaces native direct-light substrate single scattering with footprint-filtered statistical glints. Coat, multiple scattering, diffuse, emission, SH, Probe and rectangles retain their existing response. No plugin or keyword required.

properties.name: GlintDensity
properties.description: Log10 statistical facets per original UV unit area: 6 means one million. Higher density or larger pixel footprints converge toward smooth GGX. Not world-meter density; UV islands with different texel density need authoring adjustment.

properties.name: GlintContrast
properties.description: Statistical sparsity: R=10^(-3*value). Higher values give fewer, brighter events at the same expected reflection, not an energy multiplier or another roughness. Extremely rare unresolved events continuously retain the smooth mean.

properties.name: GlintSeed
properties.description: Rounded integer material seed, saved by ME. Changes the stable UV and angular statistical field. Time, frame number and light index never reseed it. Mirrored or repeated UV charts repeat the pattern.

properties.name: CoatMask
properties.description: Red channel multiplies CoatWeight. Coverage blends complete bare and coated materials, not only the top highlight.

properties.name: CoatRoughnessMap
properties.description: Red channel multiplies coat perceptual roughness. Shares the RoughnessMap sampler filter and wrap settings.

properties.name: CoatWeight
properties.description: Coating coverage. Zero uses the energy-corrected bare material and ignores every coat/film control. The stage-3 audit intentionally updates the old dielectric/mixed-metal baseline.

properties.name: CoatIOR
properties.description: Coat refractive index. Controls top Fresnel, substrate relative IOR, refraction path length and internal trapping.

properties.name: CoatRoughness
properties.description: Perceptual GGX roughness of the isotropic top interface. Also broadens both substrate anisotropic axes through rough transmission.

properties.name: CoatNormalMap
properties.description: Independent coat normal, using the selected normal encoding. Shares the RoughnessMap sampler.

properties.name: CoatNormalScale
properties.description: Coat normal strength. Zero is neutral for every encoding; base normals remain independent.

properties.name: CoatNormalBaseBlend
properties.description: Zero starts from smooth mesh normal; one inherits the base/detail normal before RNM coat normal composition.

properties.name: CoatNormalEncoding
properties.description: 0=Unity packed; 1=RGB normal; 2=alpha/green packed. Select based on actual texture storage.

properties.name: CoatNormalFlipY
properties.description: Invert tangent-space Y only on the coat normal.

properties.name: CoatNormalDataRestore
properties.description: Restore RGB data accidentally imported as sRGB in Linear mode. UnityPacked is unaffected.

properties.name: CoatThicknessMap

properties.name: CoatAbsorptionColor
properties.description: Linear single-pass transmission at CoatAbsorptionDistance. White means no absorption; not a tint added to reflections.

properties.name: CoatAbsorptionDistance
properties.description: Distance in millimeters at which the transmission equals CoatAbsorptionColor.

properties.name: CoatThickness

properties.name: ThinFilmMask

properties.description: Red channel multiplies ThinFilmThickness in nanometers. Data, not color; shared material-data sampler.

properties.description: Optional interfering substrate interface beneath coat. Zero keeps plain coat; CoatWeight zero disables film too.

properties.name: ThinFilmIOR
properties.description: Film refractive index, independent of coat and base IOR. RGB metal optical constants are an effective fit, not measured spectral data.

properties.name: SpecularHorizonStrength
properties.description: Fades probe reflections directed below the geometric surface by a perturbed normal. Does not multiply direct lights or emission; 0 disables this fade.

properties.name: SceneLighting
properties.description: Accept the optional KKS companion v1 rectangle lights. Off, missing companion, or an incompatible protocol contributes exactly zero. Does not replace native lights, Probe or SH.

properties.name: AreaLightIntensity

properties.name: EmissionIntensity

properties.name: GlintMask
properties.description: Linear red channel multiplies GlintWeight. White or no map preserves the scalar; black restores smooth direct specular. Independent ST affects only the mask, not the stable UV microstructure. Does not clip coverage.

properties.name: MainTex
properties.description: RGB base color; white multiplies BaseColor unchanged. Alpha is used only by BSDFCutout.

properties.name: NormalMap
properties.description: Normal data. Encoding is explicit; use UnityPacked for Unity-imported normals, RGB for blue normals, AG for exported alpha/green normals.

properties.name: MetallicMap
properties.description: Red channel multiplies Metallic. White or no map keeps the scalar.

properties.name: RoughnessMap
properties.description: Red channel multiplies perceptual Roughness. White or no map keeps the scalar; black is smooth.

properties.name: OcclusionMap
properties.description: Red channel multiplies Occlusion. Affects indirect diffuse and optionally probe specular through SpecularOcclusionStrength; never direct lights or emission.

properties.name: ORMMap
properties.description: Optional packed data: R=occlusion, G=roughness, B=metallic. Enabled by UseORM; multiplies the corresponding scalar values.

properties.name: EmissionMask
properties.description: RGB emission multiplied by EmissionColor and EmissionIntensity. Black or no texture produces no emission.

properties.name: AlphaMask
properties.description: Red channel multiplies MainTex alpha and Coverage. This is independent of the old skin alpha_a/alpha_b compatibility processing.

properties.name: AnisotropyMap
properties.description: Linear red-channel data multiplies Anisotropy. White or no texture retains the slider; black is isotropic. Independent ST; shares RoughnessMap filtering/wrap sampler.

properties.name: AnisotropyRotationMap
properties.description: Linear red-channel angle adds 0..360 degrees to AnisotropyRotation in the mesh UV tangent frame. Black or no texture adds zero. Independent ST; shares RoughnessMap sampler. Avoid filtered discontinuities between 0 and 1; opposite directions describe the same unoriented lobe.

properties.name: NormalMapDetail
properties.description: Independent detail normal, reoriented onto the base normal using RNM. Its UV scale and offset are independent of MainTex and NormalMap.

properties.name: BaseColor
properties.description: Base reflectance color. For dielectrics this is diffuse color; for metals it is normal-incidence specular reflectance.

properties.name: Metallic
properties.description: 0 is dielectric, 1 is conductor. Fractional values mix the two; metals have no diffuse lobe.

properties.name: Roughness
properties.description: GGX perceptual roughness; microfacet alpha=r*r with only a numerical alpha floor of 0.001.

properties.name: DiffuseRoughness
properties.description: EON diffuse roughness; 0 is Lambert. Does not change the GGX specular roughness.

properties.name: IOR
properties.description: Dielectric interface IOR relative to air. F0=((IOR-1)/(IOR+1))^2; IOR=1 disables dielectric interface reflection.

properties.name: SpecularWeight
properties.description: Weights the dielectric reflection lobe, including grazing reflection. Metals are unaffected. 1 is the physical interface reference.

properties.name: SpecularColor
properties.description: Tint of dielectric normal-incidence reflection. White is the physically neutral dielectric reference.

properties.name: UseORM
properties.description: 0 uses separate metallic/roughness/AO maps; 1 reads ORM. This is a float branch and works with MaterialEditor without keywords.

properties.name: NormalMapScale
properties.description: Scales decoded tangent-space XY then normalizes. 0 is a flat normal in every encoding.

properties.name: NormalEncoding
properties.description: 0=Unity native packed normal, 1=raw RGB XYZ, 2=raw AG XY with positive Z reconstructed. No automatic color-based guessing.

properties.name: NormalFlipY
properties.description: Flips the decoded tangent-space Y component, for the opposite normal-map convention.

properties.name: NormalDataRestore
properties.description: For raw RGB/AG only: in Linear projects, undo automatic sRGB texture decoding when the data was imported as color. Leave 0 for correctly imported linear data.

properties.name: DetailNormalMapScale
properties.description: 0 disables detail normal sampling and preserves the base normal. Increase after assigning a detail texture and its encoding.

properties.name: DetailNormalEncoding
properties.description: 0=UnityPacked, 1=raw RGB, 2=raw AG. Independent from the main normal encoding; AG reconstructs positive Z.

properties.name: DetailNormalFlipY
properties.description: Flips only the detail map tangent-space Y component before RNM blending.

properties.name: DetailNormalDataRestore
properties.description: For raw RGB/AG detail data incorrectly imported as color in a Linear project. Leave off for correctly imported normal data and in Gamma hosts.

properties.name: HeightMap
properties.description: Height-v1 linear R: white is the original mesh envelope, black is HeightScale meters inward. Shared by actual Forward, caster and camera-depth geometry. Own ST and sampler; linear import recommended. No POM trace in Tess entries.

properties.name: HeightScale
properties.description: Maximum actual inward displacement in world meters, independent of object scale. Zero returns original triangles and frame with no height samples. White stays at the original mesh. CPU culling requires expanded mesh/skinned bounds: companion support or manual authoring; shader-only displacement cannot expand them.

properties.name: IsHeightReverse
properties.description: Reverse decoded height h=1-h before displacement and derivative reconstruction. Reversed black is the original envelope; reversed white is recessed. Does not reverse coverage or the displacement mask.

properties.name: DisplacementMask
properties.description: Linear R multiplies inward displacement, not coverage. White preserves height, black pins the original mesh. Paint black at incompatible UV/normal seams with a smooth transition to prevent cracks. Has its own ST and sampler.

properties.name: TessellationMode
properties.description: 0 fixed factor; 1 shared world-space edge length. Fractional-odd subdivision uses the same endpoint-only rule in ForwardBase, ForwardAdd, native shadows and camera depth. No screen-distance LOD or silhouette smoothing. Zero HeightScale bypasses sampling and returns factor 1.

properties.name: TessFactor
properties.description: Edge subdivision factor in fixed mode, capped by TessMaxFactor. Fractional-odd hardware tessellation changes segment lengths continuously; factor 1 preserves the original triangles. Triangle cost grows approximately quadratically.

properties.name: TessEdgeLength
properties.description: Target world-space edge length in world-edge mode before displacement. Smaller lengths increase tessellation. Uses transformed endpoints, so nonuniform/negative scale and skinned input are respected. Identical in all cameras and lights; no view-dependent cracks or shadow LOD mismatch.

properties.name: TessMaxFactor
properties.description: Upper bound for both tessellation modes. D3D11 fractional-odd limit is 63. This limits GPU amplification, not displacement depth; excessive factors still cost every native light and shadow pass.

properties.name: DisplacementMip
properties.description: Explicit height/mask mip, shared across all passes and cameras. 0 uses the finest level; higher values filter geometry. Fractional values use the texture sampler's mip filter. Use a linear texture with mipmaps and match geometry density; sub-triangle detail cannot appear in the silhouette. No camera-dependent automatic mip.

properties.name: DisplacementEdgeFade
properties.description: Optional crack-safe fallback: fade displacement to zero within this barycentric distance of EVERY source triangle edge. 0 preserves continuous relief. Positive values also pin UV/normal seams but can expose triangle-shaped grooves; a seam-authored displacement mask is preferable. Does not clip alpha.

properties.name: Anisotropy
properties.description: OpenPBR-style GGX axis stretch; multiplied by AnisotropyMap red. 0 uses the original isotropic BRDF/LUT/probe path. 1 is numerically regularized per axis. Direct light uses anisotropic GGX/Smith and directional energy compensation; native Probe IBL uses an approximate bent reflection vector, not exact elliptical convolution.

properties.name: AnisotropyRotation
properties.description: Rotates the broad-slope tangent axis about the final shading normal in the UV frame; rotation-map red adds a full turn. 180 degrees is visually equivalent; 90 degrees swaps highlight axes. Mirrored UV and negative transforms preserve frame handedness.

properties.name: SpecularAAStrength
properties.description: Filters GGX from final-normal derivatives. Anisotropy broadens both squared slope axes and filters direction variation; direct light, DFG and IBL share the effective parameters. 0 restores unfiltered parameters. Cannot recover subpixel variance lost by compression/mips.

properties.name: SpecularAAVariance
properties.description: Weight of normal and anisotropic-direction derivatives. Larger values reduce tiny sharp highlights and isotropize rapidly varying directions. Neutral for a spatially constant normal and direction frame.

properties.name: SpecularAAThreshold
properties.description: Bounds the filtering kernel in microfacet-alpha space: added alpha-squared is at most threshold-squared times AA strength. 0 disables broadening.

properties.name: GlintWeight
properties.description: 0 preserves the previous material. 1 replaces native direct-light substrate single scattering with footprint-filtered statistical glints. Coat, multiple scattering, diffuse, emission, SH, Probe and rectangles retain their existing response. No plugin or keyword required.

properties.name: GlintDensity
properties.description: Log10 statistical facets per original UV unit area: 6 means one million. Higher density or larger pixel footprints converge toward smooth GGX. Not world-meter density; UV islands with different texel density need authoring adjustment.

properties.name: GlintContrast
properties.description: Statistical sparsity: R=10^(-3*value). Higher values give fewer, brighter events at the same expected reflection, not an energy multiplier or another roughness. Extremely rare unresolved events continuously retain the smooth mean.

properties.name: GlintSeed
properties.description: Rounded integer material seed, saved by ME. Changes the stable UV and angular statistical field. Time, frame number and light index never reseed it. Mirrored or repeated UV charts repeat the pattern.

properties.name: CoatMask
properties.description: Red channel multiplies CoatWeight. Coverage blends complete bare and coated materials, not only the top highlight.

properties.name: CoatRoughnessMap
properties.description: Red channel multiplies coat perceptual roughness. Shares the RoughnessMap sampler filter and wrap settings.

properties.name: CoatWeight
properties.description: Coating coverage. Zero uses the energy-corrected bare material and ignores every coat/film control. The stage-3 audit intentionally updates the old dielectric/mixed-metal baseline.

properties.name: CoatIOR
properties.description: Coat refractive index. Controls top Fresnel, substrate relative IOR, refraction path length and internal trapping.

properties.name: CoatRoughness
properties.description: Perceptual GGX roughness of the isotropic top interface. Also broadens both substrate anisotropic axes through rough transmission.

properties.name: CoatNormalMap
properties.description: Independent coat normal, using the selected normal encoding. Shares the RoughnessMap sampler.

properties.name: CoatNormalScale
properties.description: Coat normal strength. Zero is neutral for every encoding; base normals remain independent.

properties.name: CoatNormalBaseBlend
properties.description: Zero starts from smooth mesh normal; one inherits the base/detail normal before RNM coat normal composition.

properties.name: CoatNormalEncoding
properties.description: 0=Unity packed; 1=RGB normal; 2=alpha/green packed. Select based on actual texture storage.

properties.name: CoatNormalFlipY
properties.description: Invert tangent-space Y only on the coat normal.

properties.name: CoatNormalDataRestore
properties.description: Restore RGB data accidentally imported as sRGB in Linear mode. UnityPacked is unaffected.

properties.name: CoatThicknessMap
properties.description: Red channel multiplies coat thickness in millimeters. This absorption distance is not nanometer thin-film thickness.

properties.name: CoatAbsorptionColor
properties.description: Linear single-pass transmission at CoatAbsorptionDistance. White means no absorption; not a tint added to reflections.

properties.name: CoatAbsorptionDistance
properties.description: Distance in millimeters at which the transmission equals CoatAbsorptionColor.

properties.name: CoatThickness
properties.description: Medium thickness in millimeters. Reflections traverse down and up; emission traverses only the escape path.

properties.name: ThinFilmMask
properties.description: Red channel multiplies ThinFilmWeight within the coat-covered region only.

properties.name: ThinFilmThicknessMap
properties.description: Red channel multiplies ThinFilmThickness in nanometers. Data, not color; shared material-data sampler.

properties.name: ThinFilmWeight
properties.description: Optional interfering substrate interface beneath coat. Zero keeps plain coat; CoatWeight zero disables film too.

properties.name: ThinFilmIOR
properties.description: Film refractive index, independent of coat and base IOR. RGB metal optical constants are an effective fit, not measured spectral data.

properties.name: ThinFilmQuality

High-contrast or thick low-index films smoothly return to the reference path. 1: Reference, the preserved 256-512 sample integral; much more expensive. Both modes are neutral when film or coat weight is zero.

properties.name: ThinFilmThickness
properties.description: Optical interference thickness in nanometers. Below 30 nm the film smoothly fades into the plain substrate; this is not a calibrated ultrathin oxide model. Spatial phase filtering reduces distant flicker.
